summary: Cullinan Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose initial Phase 1 clinical data for CLN-978 in rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, along with plans to present at the EULAR congress. The filing covers pipeline updates without any M&A, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. No financial terms, premiums, or structural mechanics are involved. This is a routine clinical update, not a special situation.
